name: A Good Friend
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

I admit, I am a little worried, adventurer. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
narrative.objectives: Find Iverron by the cave to the north.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'm so glad you found me, adventurer. How did you know I was here?

quests.name: Iverron's Antidote
quests.objectiveText: Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up.
